title: Elegant Polka-dot Bow Cheongsam Dress For Women
body_html:
Product information:
This New Chinese-style Qipao dress blends traditional Chinese aesthetics with a vintage artistic flair. Featuring a flattering fitted waist and hip-hugging silhouette, it is crafted from polyester fabric with polka dot prints and a bow-knot zipper detail. The three-quarter sleeve design makes it suitable for daily wear, dates, parties, and annual events.

Material: Polyester
Style: Chinese Style, Vintage Artistic
Features: Polka Dot Print, Bow-knot Zipper, Fitted Waist, Hip-hugging
Colour: Pink
